text:
carla: Kicking off a compact thread for marketplace onboarding items we still need to close this sprint: offer IDs, short blurb, CTA, images, and legal QA.

ben: I'll own AWS + GCP offerId mapping. ETA tomorrow noon. Any constraints for offerId format?

mira: Azure needs planId split per SKU; I'll handle that. Also drafting 3 feature bullets for the storefront.

owen: Assets: hero + thumbnail variants ready but need sizing confirmation. AWS wants 3:2 <=1MB, GCP prefers 16:9. I'll compress if needed.

legal: Please send the listing copy and the trial duration. We need explicit data-retention language in the listing or link to privacy FAQ. 

carla: Trial proposal is 14d trial (auto-convert to paid). Add "data deleted on request within 30 days" line?

legal: Ok to 14d. Please include: "Customers may request deletion; we will remove data within 30 days" in the privacy blurb. Also note: mention KMS for Private offers.

mira: Noted. I'll add the KMS sentence to the private-offer blurb. Draft bullets: 1) Low-latency hosted inference; 2) Reserved GPU pools for scale; 3) Simple API + SDKs. Feedback?

ben: Love it. For offerId naming I'll use RED-PRO-{cloud}-{region} pattern to avoid collisions. Will push spreadsheet to Drive.

owen: Uploaded compressed images to Drive: /drive/marketplace/1727/assets. Included alt text and filenames. ops-bot validated sizes.

ops-bot: image-check: all hero images pass size checks. manifest-v3 ready; staging deploy id 402 queued.

carla: Action items recap: ben (offerId spreadsheet), mira (Azure planId + blurb + KMS line), owen (confirm assets uploaded), legal to QA final copy after blurb in doc. Preflight check Mon 9am PT. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
